transitions.historical_text: You can only use this card's effect once, and only during this turn. When a monster on your side of the field is sent to your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 monster with an ATK of 1500 points or less from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.
transitions.modern_text: If a monster on your side of the field was sent to your Graveyard this turn, you can Special Summon 1 monster with an ATK of 1500 points or less from your Deck once during this turn. Then shuffle your Deck.
transitions.summary: The TP7 text revision changed the condition from a forward-looking send after Last Will resolves to a turn-wide condition that can already be satisfied by an earlier send in the same turn. The pinned GOAT script installs an EVENT_TO_GRAVE watcher at resolution; the modern script uses a global turn flag.

corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

coverage.gap_reason: Project Ignis ships no implementation matching this version: none of the upstream historical variants in the pinned databases carries this version's card text. Reproducing it needs a custom script and a reserved passcode.

gap.behavioural_impact: Period ruling package on top of the text change. Activation condition: the modern `s.spcon`/`s.activate` both require `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,...)` before offering the Summon, while the goat `s.checkop2` prompts and consumes the effect regardless of whether a monster with 1500 or less ATK is in the Deck. Failed-search verification: the goat operation calls `Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)` when the selection comes back empty. Only the verification half is dated by the shared search-verification chronology, so this change is left unresolved.

review.notes: The official Konami card database lists TP7-EN015 with the revised "was sent ... this turn" text and the project release ledger records Tournament Pack 7 on 2005-11-01. A June 2006 Curtis Schultz discussion explicitly describes both the retroactivity change and the ability to use Last Will later in the turn as consequences of the revised text. Those two functional transitions are therefore one sourced TP7 event. Activation legality with no eligible Deck target and failed-search Deck verification are distinct ruling questions: the pinned scripts demonstrate different operations, but no source located establishes that they changed together, so they remain separate undated events with no edge between them. The verification event uses the shared TCG procedure: old behavior is positively attested through 2011-02-02 and the first located modern no-verification policy is 2019-04-03. Only TP7 -> verification is date-proven; no ordering is asserted for activation legality. The intermediate TP7 text with the old ruling package has no upstream implementation and remains a known gap.
